SCP-428: a knotted dark red growth that hangs in the air, joined by thin cords to the people walking around it.
It seeks out people. The figures on its cords keep the faces they had and whatever they carried, take hold of anyone they reach, and crowd close around it when it rests.
It starts small. Its file in the Archive says more about where it was found.

dossier.scp_unleashed.428.title: The Collective
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.caption: SCP-428 and three attached figures in temporary holding, from the observation camera.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.0.text.0: Containment of SCP-428 is under review following the incident described in Addendum 428-2. Until a revised procedure is approved, SCP-428 and every figure attached to it are to be observed by camera from outside the holding area at all times.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.0.text.1: **No one is to enter the holding area alone, and no one is to stand within reach of SCP-428 or its figures.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.0.text.2: Anyone held by SCP-428 or its figures is to be helped free by colleagues at once.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.1.text.0: SCP-428 is a knotted, roughly round growth of dark red tissue that floats a short distance above the floor without visible support. It is covered in rounded lobes and folds, and short fine threads stir across its surface. Its size has differed between observations, from smaller than a fist to wider than a doorway.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.1.text.1: SCP-428 is joined by long, very thin cords to a number of human figures. Each cord runs into the back of a figure's head. The figures keep the faces and clothing of people who went missing near SCP-428, and they walk, turn and handle objects, but they do not speak beyond a low murmur. They never stray far from the mass, and while it rests they crowd close around it, facing outward.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.1.text.2: SCP-428 drifts slowly and seeks out people. Its figures take hold of anyone they reach and keep them still for it. Several together have never been shaken off.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.2.title: Addendum 428-1: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.2.text: SCP-428 was found at the edge of a logging camp with a single figure in an orange jumpsuit standing beside it, its head bowed. The jumpsuit matched no site roster. The camp's three workers were not found.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.3.title: Addendum 428-2: Incident
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.3.text.0: SCP-428 was moved to Holding Cell 7 pending assessment. Twenty minutes later, camera footage shows one of its figures walk to the panel beside the cell door and press it. The door opened, and the figures filed out after the mass.
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.3.text.1: %rIt has learned how we leave rooms.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.4.title: Addendum 428-3: Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.428.page.4.text: The access log for the breach shows a door opened with the card of a researcher missing for a week. Guards who fired on the mass withdrew within the minute. %rSome of them were still armed.%r
gui.scp_unleashed.scp428.locked: Held too tightly to break free
